data.name: Mulerun – Retro Bootlegger Simulator
data.detailed_description:
MULERUN is a first-person crafting, farming, and business simulation game set on a mysterious tropical island in the 1980s.

After escaping a dangerous drug network, the CIA relocates you to a remote island under strict surveillance. A tracking bracelet on your ankle prevents you from traveling too far from the house they gave you.

You’re safe… but you’re also stuck.

With only a run-down shack, a few fruit trees, and some primitive tools, you must find a way to survive, produce, trade, and slowly build a business.

What begins with simple fruit juice production may grow into something far more ambitious.

If you’re clever enough.

Fruit trees, a rusty pickup, a dirt airstrip — and a little side business

the authorities would frown upon: you distill the best moonshine on the island.

Then one night, a black car stops in front of your house. The CIA knows

everything. Fifteen years in prison... or you fly for them. There is no

third option.

**Mulerun** is a first-person bootlegger simulator about building an illegal

liquor empire while serving two masters who must never learn about each other.

## DISTILL

Ferment fruit in barrels, run your still, bottle and cap your product.

Discover recipes from your grandfather's book — from honest Apple Jack to

concoctions that should probably be illegal for entirely different reasons.

Upgrade from a kitchen pot to serious hardware.

## DELIVER

Load your pickup and supply the island: the nightclub, street customers,

harbor orders. Watch your mirrors — the police patrol the roads, and a

trunk full of unlicensed liquor is hard to explain.

## FLY

Your battered plane is your greatest asset. Fly reconnaissance for the CIA:

under the radar, between patrol routes, camera loaded with the good film.

Later, other people will want your piloting skills too — and their cargo

pays much, much better. Mind the weight. The runway is only so long.

## RISK IT

Two employers. One suspicious island. Every job raises the stakes: border

inspections, tails you need to shake, evidence you need to scrub off your

plane. How long can you play both sides?

## TOGETHER

Play solo, or run the operation with up to **4 players in online co-op** —

one flies, one brews, one drives deliveries, one keeps the lights on.

Full controller support and Steam Deck in mind from day one.

data.short_description: Distill moonshine, run a farm, and fly contraband for two masters who must never meet. The CIA owns you. The cartel pays you. A first-person bootlegger sim on a 1970s tropical island — solo or in 4-player online co-op.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3.5GHz 6-Core or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 or Radeon RX 6700
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
